fields.name: Standard
documentation: Fills the bar regularly, either in a left-to-right or top-to-bottom direction as values increase.

fields.name: StandardNoRangeFill
documentation: Similar to standard, except if the range between the min and max values is zero instead render as-if the bar were 100% full. If the min and max values are both zero, will render as 0% full.

fields.name: Center
documentation: Fills the bar in an outward growing manner from the center.

fields.name: Reverse
documentation: Inverse of Standard, filling right-to-left or bottom-to-top as values increase.

fields.name: Immediate
documentation: Immediately snap to the target value with no interpolation.

fields.name: ExponentialEaseOut
documentation: Interpolate the bar toward the target value with exponential ease-out style decay.

fields.name: Linear
documentation: Render the status bar using the existing linear horizontal or vertical fill behavior.

fields.name: Radial
documentation: Render the status bar by driving the managed texture's radial progress fill percent instead of resizing the texture anchors.

fields.name: ElapsedTime
documentation: Calculate status timer bar values using the elapsed time of a duration.

fields.name: RemainingTime
documentation: Calculate status timer bar values using the remaining time of a duration.
